title: worldmodel-from-scratch: build a world model, then find out where it breaks
description: A six-lesson, dependency-light introduction to world models that measures where they fail rather than only how to build them. Lessons 1-4 need only torch, numpy and matplotlib; Lessons 5-6 add Gymnasium and MuJoCo. Every claim in the documentation is checked against the lessons' real output by a script that ships with the repository.
